K_S1C1.title: First Steps
K_S1C1.goal: Type 'forward(150)' to move the turtle to the yellow circle.
K_S1C1.learningObjective: Tell the computer to move the turtle.

K_S1C2.title: A Simple Turn
K_S1C2.goal: Type 'turn(90)' to face up. Then type 'forward(150)'.

K_S1C3.title: Corner Turn
K_S1C3.learningObjective: Move and turn in one go.

K_S1C4.title: Two Sides
K_S1C4.goal: Draw two lines. Forward 100, Turn 90, Forward 100.
K_S1C4.learningObjective: Follow a path with two steps.

K_S1C5.title: Three Sides
K_S1C5.goal: Almost a square! Forward, Turn, Forward, Turn, Forward.

K_S1C6.title: Make a Square
K_S1C6.goal: Draw all 4 sides of a square. Each side is 100 long.

K_S1C7.title: Staircase Steps
K_S1C7.goal: Climb the stairs! Forward, Turn Left, Forward, Turn Right...

G1_S1C1.title: Red and Blue
G1_S1C1.goal: Use 'penColor("red")', draw a line. Then 'penColor("blue")', draw another.

G1_S1C2.title: Jump Over
G1_S1C2.goal: Draw a line, 'penUp()', move, 'penDown()', draw again.
G1_S1C2.learningObjective: Lift the pen to jump gaps.

G1_S1C3.title: Dashed Line
G1_S1C3.goal: Draw a line with gaps. Draw, Jump, Draw, Jump.

G1_S1C4.title: Intro to Loops
G1_S1C4.goal:
Draw a long line by repeating 'forward(50)' 4 times.
Use:
repeat 4 {
  forward(50)
}
G1_S1C4.learningObjective: Use a loop to repeat commands.

G1_S1C5.title: Square Loop
G1_S1C5.goal:
Draw a square using a loop.
Use:
repeat 4 {
  forward(100)
  turn(90)
}
G1_S1C5.learningObjective: Draw a shape efficiently with a loop.

G1_S1C6.title: Colorful Line
G1_S1C6.goal: Use a loop to draw a line, changing color each time.

G1_S1C7.title: Double Loop
G1_S1C7.goal: Put a loop inside a loop! Try drawing 4 small squares.

G2_S1C1.title: My First Function
G2_S1C1.goal:
Note: Functions not yet implemented.
Goal: Define a 'box' command.
